ownership.quote: Prime Intellect, a startup that provides computing power and specialized software tools that help companies build AI agents, has raised a $130 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation.

stage.quote: has raised a $130 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation
stage.note: No YC/accelerator match found (ycombinator.com/companies/prime-intellect returns 404 — not the same company); founded 2024, last priced round is this Series A.

total_funding_usd.basis: company blog statement that the Series A brings total funding to over $150M
total_funding_usd.quote: Today, we're announcing that we've raised $130M, led by Radical Ventures, with participation from NVIDIA Ventures, Intel Capital, Dell Technologies Capital, and our existing investors — bringing our total funding to over $150M to build the open superintelligence stack.

last_round.quote: The massive round was led by Radical Ventures, with participation from Nvidia Ventures, Intel Capital, Dell Technologies Capital, Iconiq, and a long list of angel investors.

revenue.basis: TechCrunch quoting the company, at time of Series A announcement
revenue.quote: This rapid adoption has propelled the company to an annualized revenue run rate of $100 million.

note: Founded 2024 (TechCrunch). CEO/co-founder Vincent Weisser. Started as a decentralized/open-source AI compute and training company (GPU cloud, OpenDiLoCo, INTELLECT-1) before pivoting toward a full-stack agentic-RL platform (compute + RL framework + evaluation tools, incl. the Sandboxes product this card prices). Customers cited: Ramp, Zapier, Flapping Airplanes. No accelerator/incubator affiliation found; the YC companies page has no prime-intellect listing (404).
